settings.ggXEpr5-fkx_text: Why dental care is vital for your dog!
settings.ggCsdNBmGYV_text:
Bad breath and yellow teeth aren’t just cosmetic issues.
They’re usually early signs that plaque and bacteria are building up along the teeth and gumline.

When plaque isn’t removed regularly, it hardens into tartar.
That’s when gums become irritated, inflamed, and painful — a condition veterinarians call gingivitis.

 

Left untreated, dental issues can lead to:

  • chronic bad breath
  • gum disease and tooth loss
  • painful procedures under anesthesia
  • and costly vet bills later on

 

The good news?
Most dental problems start small — and are much easier to manage early, at home.
